name: John Clay
public_profile: Vincent Spaulding, a polite pawnshop assistant.
private_background: You are John Clay, a wanted criminal. The Red-Headed League was a scheme to keep Wilson in the shop while you dug toward the bank vault.
goals: Make the tunnel and the League look harmless
secrets: You dug the tunnel from the basement
story: You took a job in Wilson's shop under an alias and used the League's four-hour rule as cover.
initial_information: You told people you were developing photographs

timeline.description: A suspicious advertisement brought Jabez Wilson to the Red-Headed League, where Duncan Ross offered him easy work away from his shop.
Wilson copied the Encyclopaedia Britannica while the basement below the shop was gradually opened toward the bank.
The League office closed without warning just as the tunnel reached the bank wall.
The empty office, hidden passage, and payment records connect the recruitment scheme to a planned robbery.
The players must decide who planned the deception and who merely became part of its cover.

name: Duncan Ross
public_profile: The red-haired man who ran the League office.
private_background: You helped Clay create the League and signed Wilson's contract. You fear Clay will abandon you.
goals: Decide whether the ledger is worth revealing
story: You recruited Wilson, collected his weekly obedience, and watched the office disappear when the tunnel was ready.
initial_information: The contract required Wilson to copy books from ten to two

relationships.description: Clay gave you the plan and money.
